The '''Tel Minor system''',<ref name="EAOC" /> also known commonly as the '''Tel system''' and "'''The Green System'''," was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The system was a planetary [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that contained four [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and the white dwarf [[Tel (star)|Tel]].<ref name="FBS" />

==History==
[[Tel III]], the third planet in the system, contained the top secret [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sector headquarters [[Oracle Base]].<ref name="FBS" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the Tel Minor system was invented to account for discrepancies between the different sources,<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref> in this case the planet Tel IV.
